subject: Post-demo: token economics checklist + per-model allocation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token economics checklist + per-model allocation

Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and an ask so we can size the pilot and get you a tight pricing proposal.

Top-line from the demo: BrightByte wants to pilot two surfaces — conversational support (customer chat) and semantic search over KB + a small reranking step for candidate answers. To get the proposal right we need a short confirmation on volumes and unit targets. If you can indicate ranges below (even ballpark) we’ll produce a sample bill for 30/90/180-day runs.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday? If easier, reply inline.

1) Monthly token volume (all surfaces combined): select one
   - A: 5–10M tokens
   - B: 10–50M tokens
   - C: 50–200M tokens

2) Budget range you’re comfortable with for the pilot (monthly): free text (e.g., $2k–$10k)

3) Targeted unit economics (your ideal $/1M tokens) — if you don’t have a point, tell us the acceptable ceiling

4) Expected traffic split across surfaces (approx % of total tokens):
   - chat (session prompts + responses) — %
   - embeddings (indexing + queries) — %
   - rerank (per-query candidate scoring) — %

5) Latency SLOs for chat (p50/p95) and any hard limits for rerank (ms)

6) Any compliance/data residency constraints we should factor into Private vs Hosted sizing

Action plan after we get these: Redwood will deliver a 1-page sample pricing for 30/90/180 days (tokens, estimated cost, suggested model mix with per-model $/1M token), and a recommended pilot config (batching, KV cache, quantization suggestions).

Thanks — look forward to the numbers.

Jonas

Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics checklist + per-model allocation

Thanks Jonas — great demo. Answers inline below.

1) Monthly token volume: B (~25M tokens) to start; if pilot is successful we expect to hit ~120M/mo in 6 months.

2) Pilot budget (monthly): $8k–$15k. We can stretch to $20k for a 90-day pilot if ROI is clear.

3) Targeted $/1M tokens: goal is ~$1,100–$1,500 per 1M tokens across the mix. We know embeddings push cost per unit up — the blended target is more important.

4) Traffic split (approx):
   - chat: 65%
   - embeddings (indexing + query): 25%
   - rerank: 10%

5) Latency SLOs: chat p50 ~150–200ms, p95 <500ms. Rerank hard limit: 120ms for top-5 scoring.

6) Compliance: US only for pilot. No special residency. SOC2 compliance and a short security questionnaire are required before pilot kickoff.

We attached a quick estimate sheet (we’ll send as CSV) with approximate monthly call counts by endpoint. Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if you prefer a live walk.

—Alex
Alex Park
Head of Product | BrightByte AI
alex@brightbyte.ai | +1 (206) 555-0104
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics checklist + per-model allocation

Alex — perfect, thank you. A few quick clarifications so our pricing aligns with your unit target:

- Blended target of $1,100–$1,500 / 1M tokens is achievable if we apply these levers: model routing (chat -> cost-optimized chat model for prompts, fallback to larger model for long-tail), aggressive prefix/KV caching for chat sessions, and embedding dimensionality reduction on the index (we can provide a lossless-to-you tradeoff).

- With the 65/25/10 split, rough Redwood guidance (ballpark) for blended $/1M:
   - chat (cost-optimized LLM): $850 / 1M tokens
   - embeddings (sparse index + frequent reindexing): $2,400 / 1M tokens
   - rerank (small encoder + cross-attn scoring): $1,600 / 1M tokens

Using Alex’s 25M starting point and the split above that implies: monthly cost bands (very rough):
   - chat 16.25M tokens -> ~$13.8k
   - embeddings 6.25M tokens -> ~$15k
   - rerank 2.5M tokens -> ~$4k
   - blended ~ $32.8k / month — this is above your stated pilot budget, so we’ll need to propose optimizations or different model choices to get within $8k–$15k.

Two concrete options to hit your pilot budgets:
1) Compression-first: use a lower-dim embedding (x0.6 size) and a quantized chat model for 80% of traffic — estimated blended ~$12k–$16k/mo for 25M tokens.
2) Scope-limited pilot: limit rerank to high-value queries only and cap embeddings to incremental indexing cadence — estimated blended ~$9k–$12k/mo.

Next steps: Ben and I will draft two pricing playbooks (Compression-first, Scope-limited) with exact per-model unit price assumptions, expected latency impacts, and an ops checklist. We’ll send as a single PDF and CSV with assumptions for you to review. Can you confirm which option you prefer for the pilot? We can also include a 90-day runway example that phases the optimizations.

If you want a quick sync, Ben (copied) can join for a 20-min call Monday.

Thanks — Jonas
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: token economics checklist + per-model allocation

Alex — forwarding the recommended plan (attached) with the two pilot options Jonas mentioned. Summary of recommended pilot config is below. Please let us know which you want to proceed with and we’ll send an MSA addendum for the pilot.

Summary — recommended pilot configs\nOption A (Compression-first) — target monthly ~ $13k for 25M tokens
  - chat: route 80% to chat-small-q (quantized), 20% to chat-large for heavy contexts
  - embeddings: use embed-sparse-v1 with 0.6 dimensionality (reindex every 7 days)
  - rerank: set to top-3 only, run only on escalations (reduce candidate set)
  - config: batching window 30ms, KV cache TTL 12h, aggressive token-prefix caching
  - expected latency: chat p50 ~170ms, p95 ~420ms; rerank ~90ms

Option B (Scope-limited) — target monthly ~ $9.5k for 25M tokens
  - chat: default cost-optimized model for all sessions, no fallback to large model
  - embeddings: batch indexing, only index new docs (no full reindex during pilot)
  - rerank: disabled except for a 5% flagged traffic sample
  - config: same caching + batching defaults as above
  - expected latency: chat p50 ~160ms, p95 ~480ms

Attachments: proposed-pricing-v2.pdf (recommended playbook + assumptions), brightbyte-token-breakdown.csv

If that looks good I’ll have legal prepare the pilot SOW and we’ll schedule a kickoff.

Best,
Ben Carter
